entities.name: Query FtsH homolog
observations: 768-aa query sequence has 84.3% identity and 92.8% query coverage to reviewed Mycobacterium tuberculosis FtsH P9WQN2.
Pfam matches: FtsH_ext 12–93, AAA 199–330, AAA_lid_3 354–393, and Peptidase_M41 412–601.
Sequence analysis estimates molecular mass 82.66 kDa and theoretical pI 5.58.

entities.name: UniProt P9WQN2 FtsH
observations: Reviewed Mycobacterium tuberculosis ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease FtsH; annotated as a processive protease involved in integral membrane protein quality control.
Reference annotation reports cell membrane localization, multipass membrane character, and cytoplasmic-side orientation.
